mappings.rationale: Reporting carrier NAIC is in the single-row underwriting-company reference table; FHCF requires 10-character left-padded code.
Guidewire policy number is the policy identifier for the exposure row.
Dwelling ZIP is the risk-location ZIP, but profiled sample values are non-FL despite the fixed FL filter; confirm filtered values are valid FL 5-digit ZIPs.

mappings.transform_sql: CASE WHEN dw.ziplus4 IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(dw.ziplus4 AS STRING)) = '' THEN NULL ELSE LPAD(TRIM(CAST(dw.ziplus4 AS STRING)), 4, '0') END
mappings.rationale: Dwelling ZIP+4 add-on matches risk-location ZIP+4.
Source is named countyfips but samples look like 5-digit full FIPS, while target expects a 2-digit Florida/FHCF county code; expression takes rightmost two digits pending SME confirmation.
Fixed join filters dwelling state to FL; normalize source state to two-letter uppercase code.
HO line form appears to be the closest policy-form field, but sample codes A/B do not look like FHCF form codes such as HO3/HO5/DP1.
HO policy line effective date is the policy period start; cast timestamp string to DATE.
HO policy line expiration date is the policy period end; cast timestamp string to DATE.

mappings.transform_sql: CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(line.occupancytype)) IN ('OWNEROCCUPIED','OWNER_OCCUPIED') AND CAST(dw.numberoffamilies AS INT) = 1 THEN 'O1' ELSE 'O2' END
mappings.rationale: Guidewire occupancy plus dwelling family count can derive O1/O2, but FHCF occupancy is domain-encoded and should be confirmed.
Dwelling construction type is the closest field, but sample numeric codes may require translation to FHCF construction classes such as F/M.
Dwelling year built directly matches target year_built.
Dwelling PPC code matches Public Protection Class; cast string code to integer.
Joined coverage is dwelling Coverage A per fixed relation/profile coverage type A; amount is the dwelling limit.
FHCF hurricane deductible should use Guidewire tropical-cyclone deductible, but source is sparse in the profile; confirm whether wind/hail fallback is needed.
Coverage written premium matches target written premium; round to whole dollars.

mappings.transform_sql: CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(dw.windmitigation)) = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END
mappings.rationale: Wind mitigation flag is explicitly present; FHCF domain requires Y only when inspection is on file and all other values normalized to N.

mappings.transform_sql: CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(dw.windmitigation)) = 'Y' THEN TRIM(dw.openingprotection) ELSE NULL END
mappings.rationale: Opening protection is an OIR-B1-1802 companion value and should be reported only when wind mitigation is Y.

mappings.transform_sql: CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(dw.windmitigation)) = 'Y' THEN TRIM(line.roofcoveringtype) ELSE NULL END
mappings.rationale: Guidewire HO line roof covering type is the closest roof cover type, but FHCF roof-cover code domain requires review; report only with wind mitigation Y.

mappings.transform_sql: CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(dw.windmitigation)) = 'Y' THEN TRIM(dw.roofdeckattachment) ELSE NULL END
mappings.rationale: Roof deck attachment is an OIR-B1-1802 companion value and should be reported only when wind mitigation is Y.

mappings.transform_sql: CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(dw.windmitigation)) = 'Y' THEN TRIM(dw.rooftowallconnection) ELSE NULL END
mappings.rationale: Roof-to-wall connection is an OIR-B1-1802 companion value and should be reported only when wind mitigation is Y.

mappings.transform_sql: CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(dw.windmitigation)) = 'Y' THEN UPPER(TRIM(dw.secondarywaterresistance)) ELSE NULL END
mappings.rationale: Secondary water resistance is an OIR-B1-1802 companion Y/N value and should be reported only when wind mitigation is Y.
Dwelling latitude is already profiled as integer micro-degrees.
Dwelling longitude is already profiled as integer micro-degrees with negative Florida values.
Per-cycle constant inferred from FHCF-A-2026 context as filing-period start year; confirm for the actual data-call run.
Per-cycle fixed extract name uses the reporting year constant; confirm year before production.

Items needing SME review: county_fips because source appears to be full 5-digit FIPS while target expects 2-digit FHCF/Florida county code; policy_form because source samples are A/B rather than HO form names; occupancy_type and wind/roof-cover/reporting_year because they are domain-encoded; risk_zip because profile samples are non-FL although the pipeline applies an FL dwelling-state filter; tropical-cyclone deductible sparsity may require a business-approved fallback to wind/hail deductible.

INSURANCE_REGULATORY.BRONZE.GW_PC_POLICY p
    JOIN INSURANCE_REGULATORY.BRONZE.GW_PC_HOPOLICYLINE line ON line.policy_id = p.id
    JOIN INSURANCE_REGULATORY.BRONZE.GW_PC_HOCOVERAGE cov ON cov.policyline_id = line.id
    JOIN INSURANCE_REGULATORY.BRONZE.GW_PC_HODWELLING dw ON dw.policyline_id = line.id
